> > Fact From Story Messi's injury certainly played a role, but even so, there was just not enough room for error.
> > > Fact From Story Inter Miami was mathematically eliminated from MLS playoff contention.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A team that is eliminated from playoff contention cannot make the playoffs.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Injuries to key players can negatively impact a team's performance and ability to win games.
> Commonsense Knowledge If a team starts far behind in a league standings, it can be difficult to catch up and qualify for the playoffs.
